title: the WSG hunting and stalking slice - hunting, stalking a wounded animal and Table 31, printed p. 55, with the game-encounter list of p. 56
audit_comment: The Table 31 grid cell by cell (33 terrain rows across the five climate regions, the percent per season), the 1d6 game-encounter list (the size band, the creature dice and the yardage range), the four-turn hunting check with the party and midday modifiers, the 1d10 hit procedure and the wounded-animal stalking rules - every cell, const, bool, switch and chain limit verified against the model.

banner.title: R464: the WSG HUNTING AND STALKING slice - hunting (the four-turn check, the -5% per party member beyond the first, the -10% midday shift, the missile-weapon requirement, the 1d10 hit procedure), stalking a wounded animal (the enraged size L charge and the panicked size M flight) and Table 31 (the 33-row terrain-by-season hunting success grid), printed pp. 55-56.
banner.provenance: Ground truth three-way: the archive djvu word layer vs the pixel reads of the leaf 0055 spread (the full native 2444x3176 decode) vs vision reads of upscaled cell sheets. The two text layers garble four Table 31 cells; the pixels settled them (temperate mountains winter 25, not 15; arctic desert spring 5, not 30; tropical mountains summer and autumn 40, not 10). The game-encounter list row 6 is pixel-confirmed as size L, 1d3 creatures at 60-80 yards - the djvu 50-60 is a garble. NOTED BOOK DISCREPANCY: the p. 56 example prints a 35% chance for three hunters in a tropical forest, but Table 31 prints 50 and the party rule takes it to 40; the rule is pinned as printed and only the internally consistent examples are pinned.
banner.sentinel: All 132 grid cells and all 30 encounter list cells pinned; the hunting mechanics (the four-turn check, the party and midday modifiers, the 1d10 hit procedure, the charge and flight rules) are audit examples.

consts.name: whnRowCount
consts.comment: the Table 31 terrain row count: 5 arctic rows, 7 rows in each of the other four climate regions

consts.name: whnEncRowCount
consts.comment: the game-encounter list row count: the 1d6 dispatch

consts.name: whnCheckTurns
consts.comment: a hunting check covers four turns of hunting

consts.name: whnPartyPenaltyPct
consts.comment: each party member beyond the first lowers the encounter chance by 5%, cumulative

consts.name: whnMiddayPenaltyPct
consts.comment: from mid-morning to mid-evening the encounter chance drops by 10% (the table assumes early morning or late evening)

consts.name: whnMissileMinAvgDamage
consts.comment: a hunting missile weapon must average at least 3 hp of damage against size L (a bow qualifies; a thrown dagger or club does not)

consts.name: whnHitDieSize
consts.comment: the DM rolls 1d10 repeatedly; a result greater than the creature-count roll is a hit

consts.name: whnRetryTurns
consts.comment: when the encounter is negated because no missile weapon reaches the range, the group may hunt again after 4 more turns

consts.name: whnStalkRangeFeet
consts.comment: a wounded animal is finished off by a missile fired from 20 feet or less, or hand-to-hand

consts.name: whnWoundedLChargePct
consts.comment: a wounded size L animal charges: 50% chance it inflicts damage before any retaliation

consts.name: whnWoundedLChargeDie
consts.comment: the enraged size L charge inflicts 1d8 damage

consts.name: whnWoundedAC
consts.comment: to hit a wounded animal in the stalk, strike against AC 5

consts.name: whnWoundedMFleeRate
consts.comment: a panicked wounded size M animal flees at 18 inches per round

consts.name: whnWoundedMKillRangeFeet
consts.comment: a fleeing wounded size M animal is killed if a character gets within 20 feet and hits against AC 5

bools.name: whnNightNeedsVision
bools.comment: hunting at night is impossible without infravision or ultravision (with them, use the table as given)

bools.name: whnMeleeFinishOnly
bools.comment: a melee weapon may be used only to finish off a wounded kill, never for the hunting shot

bools.name: whnHitsOneAnimalAtATime
bools.comment: hits are applied one animal at a time until it is dead or wounded

bools.name: whnWoundedLChargesClosest
bools.comment: the enraged wounded size L animal charges one character - the closest, or a random one if two are equidistant

bools.name: whnWoundedMEscapesOnFirstMiss
bools.comment: a fleeing wounded size M animal escapes if no character hits on the first available opportunity round

chains.name: whnWoundedMFleeBand
chains.comment: the panicked size M flight direction on 1d4: 1 toward the hunters band 0, 2-3 perpendicular band 1, 4 directly away band 2

switches.name: whnHitsToKill
switches.comment: hits to kill by size band: one for size S, two for size M, four for size L

tables.name: whnHuntSuccess
tables.audit_comment: the Table 31 hunting success grid (the percent chance per terrain per season)

tables.name: whnEncounter
col_comments: the encounter size band: 0 = S, 1 = M, 2 = L
the minimum encounter range in yards
the maximum encounter range in yards

examples.note: the solitary temperate forest hunter: 30% winter, 50% in the other seasons
examples.expr: m['whnWin'](13) != 30 or m['whnSpr'](13) != 50 or m['whnSum'](13) != 50 or m['whnAut'](13) != 50

examples.note: two hunters in a tropical forest: 50% less the one-member penalty = 45%
the three-hunter party: 50% less two cumulative member penalties = 40%
hunting from mid-morning to mid-evening: 50% less the 10% midday shift = 40%
the arctic desert winter: a 5% chance
the subarctic swamp autumn: a 10% chance
